lines.text: It's late. You open your bank app. And there it is. A charge you don't recognize.
You report it. And then, you wait.
At this bank, the median wait for a first response is thirty-seven hours.
What if the answer took seconds? And what if it was right?
Meet the LATAM Bank Dispute Agent.
The customer says it in their own words. The agent finds the exact charge in their own history, and asks: is this the one?
One explanation later, it's done. A provisional credit, the card blocked, a reference number. Every fact, verified against the record.
Charged twice for one taxi? It doesn't guess. It shows the customer their own charges, and lets them choose.
Then it finds the twin in the data, and reverses one. Only one.
And when a charge should not be paid automatically, it knows not to act.
It asks the questions an advisor would call back for, then hands a person the full case file. Verified facts, the customer's account, and what is still open.
So why would a bank trust it? Because the model only reads. Policy and permissions live in code, and every fact is checked against the customer's own ledger.
We built it on a focused slice: one month of transactions. A dispute only needs recent history, and the live app never touches the raw data.
Across forty simulated scenarios, prompt injection included: zero unsafe outcomes.
Answers in seconds, for the cases it should resolve. A person, for the ones it shouldn't.
The LATAM Bank Dispute Agent. Try it live.
